output.plainSummary: The closest solid-fuel tests at 21% oxygen do not state outcomes; the closest test that does, at 20.9% oxygen, was described as extinguished in investigator notes, but its pressure and airflow were not recorded [bass-ii-b10] [bass-ii-p25]. More directly relevant fabric tests recorded SIBAL fabric burning at 20 cm/s airflow, with reported conditions of 21.6% oxygen and 14.5 psi; whether your particular fabric behaves the same way at 21% oxygen and 14.7 psi remains unknown [saffire-i].

The solid-category verdict is tested, with 158 runs within the dashboard tolerance, including 51 whose pressure was placed at nominal rather than recorded; 58 real runs are classified as Fabric overall. riskDrivers: The proposed 21% oxygen and oxygen partial pressure of 3.09 psi match the supplied sea-level reference. That reference match is not evidence that fabric cannot burn: SIBAL burning was recorded near this atmosphere [saffire-i].

The proposed airflow of approximately 20 cm/s matches the Saffire-I fabric-test airflow. The closest outcome-bearing BASS-II run has no recorded airflow, so its extinction cannot be transferred to this ventilation condition [saffire-i] [bass-ii-p25].

relevantEvidence.relevance: This is directly relevant fabric evidence at the proposed airflow and near the proposed oxygen and pressure. The supplied records do not identify the user's fabric composition or provide individual run ids.

knowledgeGaps: The supplied nearest-run list does not establish the selected fabric's outcome at 21% oxygen, 14.7 psi and approximately 20 cm/s. The closest fabric-specific evidence is SIBAL burning at reported conditions of 21.6% oxygen and 14.5 psi with 20 cm/s airflow [saffire-i]; a test of the actual cabin fabric at the proposed condition, with measured pressure and an explicitly recorded outcome, would close this material-and-condition gap.

recommendedTests.test: Test the actual cabin fabric in microgravity at 21% oxygen, measured 14.7 psi and approximately 20 cm/s airflow. Document its composition and configuration, ignition procedure, flame spread and final outcome.
recommendedTests.rationale: This extends the nearest outcome-bearing solid run [bass-ii-p25] to the selected material with controlled pressure and airflow, and extends the nearby SIBAL fabric evidence [saffire-i] to the exact proposed cabin condition.

prevention: Do not interpret solid-category coverage or nearby extinction notes as clearance for the selected fabric. Nearby fabric tests recorded burning [saffire-i].
Use this evidence to support engineering judgment alongside NASA-STD-6001 and certified material testing, not as a replacement for them.
suppression: Do not credit ventilation at approximately 20 cm/s with extinguishing a fabric fire: SIBAL burning was recorded at that airflow, while the nearest extinction run lacks an airflow value [saffire-i] [bass-ii-p25].
